people.name: Aino-Kaarina Väänänen
people.role: Guest of honour; hard of hearing

seating.notes: Seat Aino-Kaarina directly next to Päivikki, with clear access to the interpreter and microphone.

menu.dish: Roasted tomato and seasonal vegetable salad
Herb-roasted chicken with potatoes and seasonal vegetables; provide a vegetarian alternative

photographer: Book a photographer other than Lumière Fotografia; agency framework rates do not apply to Lumière for this event.
venue_notes: Tell the quinta Pimienta, a dog, will attend as ring bearer.
No nuts anywhere in catering, including the cake; Eero’s nephew carries an EpiPen.
Provide Päivikki Järvenpää with a microphone for Finnish interpretation.
If the forecast is over 32°C, move cocktails from the olive grove to the wine cellar.
If the ceremony starts late, shorten cocktails; do not shorten the ceremony.
Menu cards: add Finnish only if more than 25 of Eero’s family confirm attendance.
Budget total requires vendor quotes and confirmation; keep all-in spend at or below €42,000.
